name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Ltd.
about: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited provides health insurance products in India. It offers retail health insurance products for individuals and families; group health insurance products for employer/employee and non-employer/employee groups, including small-to-medium enterprises; and personal accident and travel insurance products. The company also provides star women care insurance policy that provides surrogacy and oocyte donor covers; and star special care product that covers children diagnosed with autism and for outpatient specialized treatments. In addition, it offers star health assure insurance policy, star cancer care platinum insurance policy, senior citizens health insurance policy, and star cardiac care insurance policy  platinum, as well as star group OPD care insurance product. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~23% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~14% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 31 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 44), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 31 vs sector median 20; peers with similar ROE and growth trade nearer 20, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
